milestone.title: M24.13 manual smoke checklist sign-off (HUMAN GATE)

intent.outcome: master-plan/smoke-checklist.md is fully re-run and signed off by a human on real Homebrew after M13 (Deps) is fixed. Failures become follow-up milestones; pass unblocks stable release tagging work.

problem.description: Partial smoke 2026-08-01 left most items skipped and Deps failing (M13). Agents cannot complete the human gate. Checklist path is master-plan/smoke-checklist.md (not master-plan-bkp).

in_scope: After M13 done: human re-runs master-plan/smoke-checklist.md end-to-end on macOS/Linux with real brew.
Fill Environment table; mark each item [x] pass or [ ] fail with notes.
Commit signed checklist (or attach evidence note via mp).
Each failure → one follow-up milestone (intent/problem/AC) linked via depends_on where useful.
M08 complete only when all items pass OR every fail has a tracked follow-up and M08 is explicitly blocked with the list.
out_of_scope: M14–M16 visual polish verification beyond checklist items that already cover navigation/UI.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every item in master-plan/smoke-checklist.md is [x] pass, or each fail is paired with a follow-up milestone id noted in the checklist.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: inspect master-plan/smoke-checklist.md; all boxes resolved

acceptance_criteria.description: If any item failed, follow-up milestone(s) exist with problem text referencing the failing checklist item.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: mp list milestones shows follow-ups; cross-check checklist notes

acceptance_criteria.description: Environment table (date, tester, versions, OS) is filled on the signed checklist.

design_decisions.choice: No agent execution of smoke body; runner prepares build, human signs
design_decisions.rationale: Requires real brew mutations and visual judgment. M13 must land first so Deps is not a known blocker.

steps.action: Build bin/lazybrew from current wip; record version. Ensure M13 is complete first.
HUMAN: run master-plan/smoke-checklist.md end-to-end; fill Environment; mark each item.
For each fail, create follow-up milestone via mp; note ids on checklist. If all pass, mark M08 complete evidence.
